chunks: Amir al-Mu'minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام said to Shurayh:
O Shurayh, you have sat in a position that none has sat in except a prophet, the executor of a prophet, or a wretched person.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, a title of Imam Ali عليه السلام
key_terms.مَجْلِسًا: a seat or position of authority

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali عليه السلام say about the danger and responsibility of sitting in judgment?
ai.summary: Imam Ali عليه السلام warns Shurayh about the gravity of occupying the seat of judgment. The narration emphasizes that judicial authority is an immensely serious station, fit only for one divinely guided or else it becomes a source of ruin for the unworthy.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3223 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said to Shurayh:
"O Shurayh, you have sat in a position that none has sat in except a prophet, the executor of a prophet, or a wretched person."
